change_note: 1.1 (before any generation): size raised to mirror the usable TrashNet class counts (2,521 images) so the primary and secondary datasets are compared at equal size; prompt vocabulary widened for diversity at that size.
nature: AI-generated synthetic images approved by the instructor as the study's primary dataset. No photograph was taken of a real object.
fixed_before_generation: Generation, quality control, split and experiment settings below are fixed before any image is generated or any model is evaluated on this set.

generator.license: Stability AI Non-Commercial Research Community License (sai-nc-community); non-commercial and research use
generator.crop: centre crop to 4:3, matching the TrashNet resized archive's 512 x 384 frame

prompt_template: a realistic smartphone photo of {condition} {item}, {setting}, {lighting}, {angle}, single object centred and in focus

paper: a sheet of white printer paper
a notebook page with illegible handwriting
a paper envelope with no writing
a paper flyer with blurred printing
plastic: a plastic milk tea cup with a lid
trash: a plastic straw and its wrapper

class_descriptions.cardboard: a cardboard box or cardboard packaging
class_descriptions.glass: a glass bottle or glass jar
class_descriptions.metal: a metal can or aluminium item
class_descriptions.paper: a sheet of paper, a newspaper or a paper bag
class_descriptions.plastic: a plastic bottle or plastic container
class_descriptions.trash: non-recyclable waste such as a snack wrapper, styrofoam or a used mask

quality_control.target_counts_source: usable TrashNet images per class in data/splits.csv (2,521 total)
quality_control.selection: round-robin over items in candidate order so every item is represented

split: group = class|item|setting; StratifiedGroupKFold(20, shuffle=True, random_state=42); folds 0-13/14-16/17-19 as in protocol.json

experiments.domain_shift: the five frozen TrashNet research checkpoints are evaluated without change on every primary-set image and on the primary test split
experiments.fine_tune: MobileNetV2 with protocol.json settings trained on TrashNet train plus primary-set train; epoch chosen by macro F1 on the combined validation split; evaluated once on the TrashNet test split and once on the primary-set test split
experiments.deployment: models/deployment.json is not changed; the fine-tuned model is an optional second model in the app

claim_limit: Results on synthetic images measure transfer to generated scenes. They do not measure accuracy on real campus waste.
